basis: Supplied September 16 audit and reviewed amendments

findings.title: Micro-icon hierarchy

findings.title: Role and independence
findings.evidence: Short role line plus live explicit independence copy. Possible confusion is not treated as proven; no recognition study conducted.

findings.title: Small raster copy
findings.evidence: Long descriptor and category row replaced by two short readable-role lines. Existing hero meaning provided as live text; images-disabled demo checked.

findings.title: Website metadata
findings.evidence: Required OG fields and paths supplied. Local routing and dimensions tested; no deployed-site claim.

findings.title: Editability
findings.evidence: Path-based symbols, JSON geometry/layout and editable-text SVG counterparts. Hybrid social artwork explicitly identified.

findings.title: Background adaptability
findings.evidence: True transparent light/dark and monochrome marks. Opaque icon tiles intentional; no extra maskable/native-app scope added.

findings.title: Reuse/provenance
findings.evidence: Originals preserved, source linkage documented. No automatic public license or credential trust validation claimed.

findings.title: Color interpretation
findings.evidence: New exports tagged sRGB. Original RGB interpreted, not colorimetrically recovered. Retained original bytes unchanged.
